paper_title: Constraints on axionlike particles with H.E.S.S. from the irregularity of the PKS 2155-304 energy spectrum
notes: H.E.S.S. spectral irregularity search on PKS 2155-304. Conservative galaxy cluster magnetic field limit g_agamma < 2.1e-11 GeV^-1 for ALP mass ~15-60 neV (abstract states 15-60 neV; text mentions peak around 20-25 neV). Encoded as horizontal line spanning 15-60 neV. An optimistic IGMF limit of ~5e-11 GeV^-1 near 1 neV is also quoted but with large uncertainty. Not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density. Limits also apply to scalar bosons. | selector: text (sole candidate)
